big_case.notes: Immediate irreversible life-and-death stakes and allegations affecting Florida's execution administration give this application significance beyond an ordinary private dispute. Its vehicle is nevertheless a fact-bound emergency request after adverse evidentiary findings, not a broad doctrinal decision.

leakage.notes: All 67 calls occurred November 4, before the November 5 resolution. All results are outcome_only (coverage 0.0), so null dates/digests do not prove empty retrieval. Queries include the live application and companion dockets and pre-resolution lower-court materials; prose reports the response filed November 4 and the application still pending. That later-than-baseline signal is permissible forward retrieval. No query or prose shows this application's completed disposition. Assessment is limited to query content, timestamps and staged prose, not independently observed page contents.
